# The Athletter by Josh Gessner

> > Newsletter from former MLB pitcher Josh Gessner covering pitching velocity development, mental toughness, and performance optimization through ThePitcherLab training systems.

Josh Gessner, a former Philadelphia Phillies and Texas Rangers pitcher, shares evidence-based training protocols, personal MLB experiences, and sports psychology insights for baseball players. The site features detailed velocity training programs, injury prevention protocols, and mindset development strategies from The Curious Competitor philosophy.

## Key Topics

- Pitching velocity development
- ThePitcherLab training systems
- Josh Gessner MLB experience
- Baseball mental toughness
- Pitcher mechanics optimization
- Rate of Force Development (RFD)
- Velocity-Based Training (VBT)
- Shoulder injury prevention
- Sports psychology for athletes
- Philadelphia Phillies organization
- Minor League Baseball development
- Athletic performance mindset
- Baseball recruiting strategies
- 40% Rule mental training
- Arrival Fallacy concept

## Velocity Training Programs

- [The exact weekly routine I used to throw 96mph](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/the-exact-weekly-routine-i-used-to-throw-96mph): Josh Gessner's weekly training plan that gained 16mph in 16 months
- [How I trained to throw 96mph at 18 y/o](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/how-i-trained-to-throw-96mph-at-18-y-o-cf398900361ceb78): Josh Gessner's personal velocity training program to reach 96mph
- [How to Throw Harder than 99% of Pitchers](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/how-to-throw-harder-than-99-of-pitchers-242328ab56565c56): Rate of Force Development and VBT for pitching velocity gains
- [We Told Him How To Throw 90mph](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/we-told-him-how-to-throw-90mph): Pitcher Lab case study on fixing mechanics to reach 90mph velocity
- [The EXACT Process Behind an 8 - 10](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/the-exact-process-behind-an-8-10): Velocity training case study for pitchers under 90mph

## Pitcher Development & Training

- [Re: Your Pitching Development Plan](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/re-your-pitching-development-plan): Josh Gessner discusses pitching development and winter training programs
- [Anti-Shoulder Pain Protocol](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/anti-shoulder-pain-protocol-669a): ThePitcherLab shoulder injury prevention protocol for baseball players
- [How to Become a LEGIT Prospect](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/how-to-become-a-legit-prospect): Baseball recruiting advice for pitchers targeting college programs
- [The Jefferson Curl](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/the-jefferson-curl): Jefferson Curl exercise for spinal mobility in baseball pitchers

## Mental Toughness & Sports Psychology

- [Baseball Isn't Just a Game.](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/baseball-isn-t-just-a-game): Josh Gessner on mental toughness and overcoming yips with the Phillies
- [How to develop an unbreakable mindset](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/develop-unbreakable-mindset): Navy SEALs' 40% Rule for mental toughness and overcoming limits
- [How to Destroy your Fears](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/destroy-fears): Three-step framework for overcoming fear using sports psychology
- [Use Your Dark Side](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/use-your-dark-side): Using insecurity as fuel for athletic performance and motivation
- [Bob Bowman](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/bob-bowman): Michael Phelps' coach on visualization and mental training techniques
- [If you're a young Baseball Player](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/youre-young-baseball-player): Mental game and off-field development advice for young athletes

- [What it's like to get traded in MLB](https://joshgessner.beehiiv.com/p/like-get-traded-mlb): Josh Gessner's personal experience being traded from Phillies to Rangers
